stem.flightsim.coaching_energy_complete: Ujeeddooyinka maaraynta tamarta waa la arkay. Marka xigta, ku tababar xakamaynta tamarta markaad masaafo gaaban uga soo dhowaanayso garoonka, dabadeed barbar dhig heerka hoos-u-degidda iyo taabashada dhulka.

stem.flightsim.geoq_paused: Duulimaadka waa loo hakiyey su'aashan. Xir su'aalaha, dabadeed dooro Sii wad markaad diyaar u tahay duulimaadka.
